method: Inclusion is every species printed under the Insectivora: Soricidae heading on the 2011 Wayback SANParks KNP mammal checklist PDF (6 species). English and Afrikaans names, and species order, are taken from that PDF. Scientific names are the 2011 names unless an iNaturalist taxon record cited in remaps gives a current name. Research-grade counts are for iNaturalist place_id 69020. iNaturalist-only soricids are in candidates, not species. The PDF was fetched to a temporary path for text extraction and was not copied into this project.

gaps: Live SANParks checklist HTML and PDF were not fetched in this session (Phase 1 recorded HTTP 403). Inclusion is the 2011 Wayback PDF only, and has not been compared with the live 147–148 figure.
iNaturalist checklist 8810 was not fetched (Phase 1 recorded HTTP 403/401).

All six official soricids have 0 research-grade iNaturalist observations in place 69020. The five official Crocidura species are absent from the place taxonomy tree (no observations of any grade under those names; 2 observations are identified only to genus Crocidura). Suncus lixa has 1 observation of any grade. Absence of an iNat record was not treated as absence from KNP.

Suncus varilla is an iNaturalist-only species in the place (0 research-grade, 1 of any grade). It is a separate active iNaturalist species, not a synonym of Suncus lixa, so it was not used to remap the official greater dwarf shrew.
No English remap is stored for Swamp musk shrew or Greater dwarf shrew: the iNaturalist preferred_common_name differs only by capitalisation (Swamp Musk Shrew, Greater Dwarf Shrew).
Genus-rank Crocidura identifications in the place taxonomy tree were not treated as candidates and were not assigned to any official species.
Candidate Afrikaans names were left null. The Phase 2 rule was to take af from the 2011 SANParks checklist; these taxa are not on that list.

No rare, reintroduced, or introduced flags are recorded for official Soricidae species: the 2011 PDF does not mark any of them with an asterisk or other status note (asterisks on that list are only for house mouse and house/black rat under Muridae).
The current live official list, Skinner & Chimimba, and Stuart's guide were not available to corroborate remaps or flags.
